source_edits.name: card_perpetual_timepiece
source_edits.reason: The native mill call at 0x23af823 goes directly to the zero-return epilogue. Restore exclusive resolution modes: do not reread info_slot and potentially shuffle after mill callbacks. The shuffle path still tests the current info_slot when the mill condition is false. No activation/storage quirks are changed.

source_edits.name: card_kefnet_the_mindful
source_edits.reason: Express the native attack/ability branches followed by one target setup, getter and generic-activation continuation. Keep legend/indestructibility calls first, humiliation only after affected/hand guards, setup before draw, the getter before draw, and live selected-target read after the picker. EVENT_* is a by-value parameter, so the event arms remain exclusive across callbacks. No new full-function match claimed.

source_edits.name: card_stormfist_crusader
source_edits.reason: Name the two saved player coordinates independently. Keep the first current_turn snapshot after upkeep dispatch and before drawing, and reread current_turn only after the first draw/life-loss pair to select the second player. No snapshot is replaced with a live read across a callback.

source_edits.name: card_treetop_defense
source_edits.reason: Split the cast-result/attacker-index temporary and name the saved attacking player. Preserve current_turn capture after basic_spell, the live active-card loop bound after each query, short-circuit flag lookup, native phase/flag values and pump-before-kill resolution. The repeated initial bound check has no intervening call or volatile access.

source_edits.name: card_underworld_cerberus
source_edits.reason: Split two register-reused player/count locals into independent player snapshots and a result. Preserve exile/setup order, current_turn reread after the first grave-to-hand call, saved array index across each call, and the native AI calculation. Do not impose an assumption that callbacks leave current_turn unchanged.

source_edits.name: target_has_league_watermark
source_edits.reason: Restore the native DWARF int iid local. Keep the signed internal-ID test and unsigned 16-bit backup-ID promotion (native XOR EAX,EAX; MOV AX,DX), followed by the existing watermark helper and error/NULL result. No record width or fallback behavior changes.

source_edits.name: set_base_pt
source_edits.reason: Make the native 32-bit SUB/ADD wrap explicit instead of reconstructing signed-overflow undefined behavior. Keep the old base snapshot, new base store, characteristic-bit clear and event-result update. Current emitted code already uses the same wrapped machine operations; this is source fidelity for the complete input bit domain, not a demonstrated gameplay regression.

source_edits.name: card_tibor_and_lumia
source_edits.reason: Restore the native trigger-time blue query, red query, test initialization order. Keep both saved colors across initialization. The later resolution-time color queries, target callbacks and red damage continuation are unchanged. No newly demonstrated gameplay defect is asserted for this setup-order restoration.

source_edits.name: card_harness_the_storm
source_edits.reason: Restore the native trigger-time get_card_name snapshot before default_test_definition and use the saved ID afterward. Preserve all in-play, humiliation, trigger/affected/controller/hand guards and the later separate resolution-time name lookup. No new arbitrary callee equivalence assumption or gameplay-bug claim.

source_edits.name: card_skyclave_apparition
source_edits.reason: Split the merged duh-mode/owner temporary and select the native high halfword through inst_info_t.data2. The header defines both id and data2 as uint16_t; the previous packing expression equals data2 for every field value. Preserve the two distinct inst_info calls after token initialization and the ETB owner-before-CMC snapshot sequence.

source_edits.name: graft_trigger
source_edits.reason: Reconstruct the positive ETB/affected/controller/counter guard and give the trigger mode its own local. Keep AI is_what before conditional toughness query and read trigger_cause_controller only after those queries when applicable. Test setup remains after mode selection; the separate EVENT_ETB counter transfer uses live trigger coordinates afterward.

source_edits.name: triskelion_like_creature
source_edits.reason: Consolidate the native duplicated target setup after the same four-event filter. EVENT_RESOLVE_ACTIVATION and EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE are adjacent (0x72/0x73); explicit event membership preserves the original unsigned interval. Keep ETB counters before filtering, validation before damage and the final activation-helper call even after damage.

source_edits.name: is_aura_or_equipment
source_edits.reason: Reconstruct the ordered short-circuit predicate and ordinary boolean return. Keep equipment lookup first, enchantment-type lookup only on failure, and a fresh cards_data[iid].id read after that lookup before checking aura subtype. The second subtype result is still normalized to 0/1.

source_edits.name: altar_extended
source_edits.reason: Separate the chosen sacrifice-card index from boolean availability queries. Keep all three queries in native order even when their act_mode bits are clear. Preserve the getter before event dispatch, per-stat query/store interleaving, kill before conditional tap and native availability-bit arithmetic.

source_edits.name: check_for_flanking_removal
source_edits.reason: Split state/opponent and candidate-ID/result temporaries into the state guard, saved opponent and candidate index. Keep in_play then ID then conditional humiliation, including the native -1 short-circuit, and reread the active count after each query iteration. No helper query is hoisted across a callback.

source_edits.name: card_natural_reclamation
source_edits.reason: Reconstruct the native affected-CAST branch with its shared zero result, retaining the exact spell_fizzled==1 cancellation test. Cascade remains after generic_spell, only when that test permits it. Other events and unaffected CAST still return card_disenchant directly.

source_edits.name: select_target_maybe_force
source_edits.reason: Remove redundant result=0 comma assignments from the retry eligibility predicate: its enclosing branch already proves result==0 and no intervening call can change that local. Preserve live ai_is_speculating lookup, controller-mask checks, retry packet with only preferred_controller XOR1, and success-only AI penalty.

source_edits.name: card_aysen_crusader
source_edits.reason: Replace the remaining decompiler placeholder scan index with candidate. Keep every native Soldier/Warrior short-circuit query and the live active-card loop bound; the base2 characteristic remains added only after the scan. No control-flow or gameplay change.

source_edits.name: card_necroskitter
source_edits.reason: Restore the native fresh get_card_instance after nonzero GFP resolution, instead of caching it before duh_mode/resolve_gfp_ability. Keep the kill-code getter before those callbacks and the later getter even for a negative nonzero amount, with the positive bounded loop still deciding reanimation. Use the native kill_code==0 predicate; the current unsigned field also made <=0 equivalent.

source_edits.name: card_scythe_of_the_wretched
source_edits.reason: Restore native death-scan query order: in_play, creature test, token test, stored-count guard, is_this_dying, death-trigger-removal check, then a fresh stored-count loop condition. This retains live affected coordinates between callbacks and avoids invoking removal checking for candidates rejected earlier by the native code. Also clamp the damage-record index locally and store the final count only after both target writes, as native code does. No rules fixes, capacity changes or invented safety checks.

source_edits.name: card_narcissism
source_edits.reason: Restore the native CHECK_ABILITIES sequence: mana query, sacrifice query, then live hand_count read and minimum. The MIN macro already evaluates each argument once; the issue is the unsequenced hand-count read plus sacrifice call inside the second argument, not duplicate evaluation. Preserve recursive availability check, signed minimum, AI characteristic updates and all activation/resolution paths.

source_edits.name: gift_of_immortality_legacy
source_edits.reason: Restore native owner/IID reads after the EOT in_play callback, not before it. Target2 coordinates for the final reanimation also remain live after the callback. Preserve the initial GFP owner snapshot across reanimation, failure-only early exile and the later unconditional EOT exile.

source_edits.name: card_erg_raiders
source_edits.reason: Reconstruct the native mark-on-resolution/attack and own-turn EOT paths without a merged current-turn/trigger-result local. Read current_turn after the last possible attack/getter callback; the native final snapshot differs only by its position around an ordinary nonaliasing info_slot store, with no intervening callback. Keep the fresh getter after damage before reset. Ordinary valid nonvolatile records/globals are assumed.

source_edits.name: card_hungering_hydra
source_edits.reason: Separate opponent/blocker count, blocker/damage pointers and damage-index/count/amount locals. Preserve both live active-card scans, AL_STATIC before them and independent AL_TRIG afterward, count-before-target store order, fresh trigger-time getter and the complete local damage snapshot/reset before counter callbacks. The resolve loop uses the saved count rather than a callback-mutated info_slot. Native capacities/quirks remain; no safety clamps or local unions are introduced.

source_edits.name: card_symmetry_sage

source_edits.name: effect_soul_echo
source_edits.reason: Keep attached coordinates separate from upkeep-trigger result, and express native wrapped32 subtraction after remove_counters. source_edits.name: card_agent_of_treachery

source_edits.reason: Restore native APNAP p/macro_apnap scopes, separate packed hit counts from player coordinates and preserve post-action target reset on both passes. current_turn is reread at the second pass after callbacks, not snapshotted across both players. Preserve one trigger action per nonzero packed player count.

source_edits.name: card_explore_the_vastlands
source_edits.reason: Restore native APNAP p/macro_apnap and selected. Keep the initial test initialized only once, including its native mutation carried into the second player pass. Preserve selected-card query before second test initialization, saved p across chooser/life callbacks, fresh current_turn on next pass, source kill and basic-spell continuation.

source_edits.name: rushed_rebirth_legacy
source_edits.reason: Restore native scoped inst/p/c/affected/num/mv/result rather than reusing value and controller_or_cmc. Keep initial coordinates for removal/getter, fresh attached coordinates after that getter, per-field record stores, CMC before live creature query, and separate GFP resolution plus cleanup kills. Signed nonzero do-loop and native kill-code byte test remain.

source_edits.name: card_arcane_signet
source_edits.reason: Separate scan count, primary IID, partner IID and commander pointer. Restore native count name; semantic IID names correspond to DWARF fake1/fake2 without reusing a scan index. Preserve live info_slot after each remainder-color callback and partner IID read after the first callback, no new primary-IID guard, live active bound and final mana continuation.

source_edits.name: card_elder_mastery
source_edits.reason: Restore native APNAP p/macro_apnap, removing packed-count/turn-player reuse. The first player stays fixed across its discard loop; the second player is selected from fresh current_turn after those callbacks. First-slot decrements remain visible if the second pass selects the same player. Extra final writes to the private second slot are dead and unobservable; no pointer to the local array escapes.

source_edits.name: card_cry_of_the_carnarium
source_edits.reason: Restore two distinct native APNAP p/macro_apnap/c scopes. Each player gets a reverse starting-count snapshot; no forward/live-bound conversion. Native cached current_turn reads inside the first scan are consumed only at the next player/phase boundary; APNAP reads the same live value there after callbacks. Keep exile-marking phase before all pumps, then grave exile, legacy, source kill and generic continuation.

source_edits.name: card_dauthi_warlord
source_edits.reason: Restore native p/pt/count and ordered live battlefield scans. In-play precedes shadow query; normalized nonzero contribution preserves the native ADD/SUB boolean count and final PT setter. No humiliation or other new rule checks.

source_edits.name: card_aethersnatch
source_edits.reason: Restore native spell/iid/card_added and separate validity/mode/controller roles. Keep two CAST getters; mode reread after one-target deflection can still cause multi-target deflection in the same resolution. IID is saved before obliteration, target fields stay live after deflections, and controller is read only after put_into_play before native owner-state writes.

source_edits.name: has_only_1_target_and_can_legally_change_target_to_attached
source_edits.reason: Restore native spell/targeting/attached coordinates/prev_9/rvalue roles and separate target coordinate from callback result. Use native target_t snapshot instead of two scalar stack-slot stand-ins. Disjoint field reads/writes without intervening callbacks may be scheduled differently; set flag, card callback, full target restore, remove flag and rejection strings retain order.

source_edits.name: count_different_mana_values_among_card_exiled_with_study_counter
source_edits.reason: Restore native zero-initialized manacosts[20], mc/c/inst/cmc scopes, removing shared zeroing/count index and pointer cursor. Keep in-play/type/fresh-getter/callback-identity/study-counter/CMC order, live target IID after count callback and live active bound. Native unchecked CMC indexing remains; no new capacity rule.

source_edits.name: count_how_many_times_a_commander_was_played
source_edits.reason: Restore native edh_card/amount and separate second counter result from card coordinate. Keep sentinel guard, VORTEX then VELOCITY queries, first count snapshot across second callback and two signed divisions before addition.

source_edits.name: card_vances_blasting_cannons
source_edits.reason: Restore native csvid and separate storm-count predicate from trigger mode. Keep CSVID snapshot before exile, native CSVID-as-IID is_what argument and missing empty-deck guard, storm query before duh choice and spell trigger; global enchantment behavior remains canonical.

source_edits.name: card_pteramander
source_edits.reason: Restore native cless and canonical four-event filter, replacing compiler result-zero guard scaffolding. Preserve grave query then cost subtraction and adapt packet, including native negative colorless costs.

source_edits.name: card_sol_talisman
source_edits.reason: Express the native four activation events plus COUNT_MANA route directly, keeping every other event routed to suspend_only. No new spell/resolution route or result-register requirement.

source_edits.name: card_dauthi_cutthroat
source_edits.reason: Share native four-event setup while preserving shadow before filter, target definition/callback/getter order and ACTIVATE-only flags-seven literal prompt return. Other activation events retain flags-five/null prompt, with validation before live target kill.

source_edits.name: card_ancestral_knowledge
source_edits.reason: Restore native deck/amount/selected, separate initial deck count from picker result and share one leaves-play continuation. The ten-card cap preserves the initial nonzero predicate; deck pointer remains saved before count callback. Keep exile/decrement/picker order, rearrange before leaves_play, then leave-ability shuffle and enchantment tail.

Before source additionally queried can_target and generic_spell on this event. Preserve CHANGE_TARGET target selection, ordinary CAN_CAST validation and both resolution effects. Native raw event dispatch and continuation confirm the distinction; do not invent a retargetability rule.

source_edits.name: card_brutal_hordechief
source_edits.reason: Native 0x2628309/0x2628329 call store_attackers/dat_ability before accepted-GAA instance queries at 0x2628355/0x262837f. Remove unconditional pre-trigger getter and query only on CAN/ACT/RESOLVE/CLEANUP. DAT life effects and activation costs/parent fields retain their ordering.

source_edits.name: card_star_compass
source_edits.reason: Native 0x218d09e/0x218d0c7 and change-type path 0x218d10f/0x218d121 perform a second instance query when the first mana_color is nonzero. Restore that conditional query instead of folding both reads through the saved pointer. Existing per-land ID query and zero-mana behavior stay intact.

source_edits.name: card_elite_scaleguard
source_edits.reason: Native target constructor 0x26243e9 precedes the sole DAT instance query 0x2624408 and info_slot load 0x262440f. Remove extra pre-constructor getter/count snapshot; derive the loop count from the post-constructor instance. Per-iteration can_target and fresh selected target fields remain.

source_edits.name: card_unsubstantiate
source_edits.reason: Make native left-before-right callback sequencing explicit: counterspell_validate returns before fresh info_slot==67 and valid_target. Both native 0x2479021/0x2479033 and pre-edit current code already implement this sequence. This removes unspecified bitwise-operand evaluation ordering without claiming an existing compiled bug.

source_edits.name: scrylike_effect
source_edits.reason: Explicitly finish count_deck before reading the chosen IID from the saved deck pointer. Native 0x26542b2 precedes selected load 0x26542c3; current pre-edit instructions already do so. Preserve saved deck pointer, repeated initial counts, mutable test.qty and human/AI decisions.

source_edits.name: card_whir_of_invention
source_edits.reason: Reconstruct common generic-spell continuation. Only CAN, affected CAST and CHANGE_TARGET run improvise before it; RESOLVE and CAN_CHANGE_TARGET skip improvise. Other events return improvise. Keep both instance queries around formatting and the post-kill generic call.

source_edits.name: card_guiding_voice
source_edits.reason: Consolidate repeated pump fallbacks while retaining target constructor/getter on all accepted GS events, resolution counter before learn, and fallback even for other events/unaffected casts.

source_edits.name: card_defy_death
source_edits.reason: Flatten human/AI/Angel branches into one existing generic-spell continuation. AI alone sets Angel and conditionally reinitializes the test; reanimation/kill still precede resolution fallback. Keep affected-cast recheck after initial constructor.

source_edits.name: card_allosaurus_shepherd
source_edits.reason: Replace decompiler nested while/do scan and repeated GAA exit with forward for loop and common return. Preserve original unsigned event-range predicate, no added in_play check, is_what-before-subtype order and fresh active_cards_count after every callback.

source_edits.name: card_rhet_crop_spearmaster
source_edits.reason: Share duh_mode/dat_ability continuation across all events, keeping affected CHECK_ABILITIES updates before duh_mode. Distinguish exertion and pump handles; preserve nonzero alternate_legacy_text gate and all callback order.

source_edits.name: card_dauntless_dourbark
source_edits.reason: Restore named sum/other-Treefolk roles and a normal forward scan. Preserve unsigned characteristic-event range, player==-1 guard, live scan bound and sequential Treefolk then Forest queries. Empty battlefield still sets characteristic PT to zero; abilities only adds trample.

source_edits.name: card_twitch
source_edits.reason: Consolidate target setup and generic-spell returns, including generic after resolution kill. Keep post-generic affected-cast recheck before AI twiddle adjustment; resolution validates, twiddles and draws in order.

source_edits.name: card_sorcerous_sight
source_edits.reason: Reconstruct common target setup/getter and generic-spell continuation. Preserve accepted-event guard, second affected-cast check before AI adjustment, reveal before draw and generic after resolution kill.

source_edits.name: card_plague_boiler
source_edits.reason: Express upkeep/static/activation counter branches directly and share the GAA continuation. Static sacrifice precedes nonland sweep, zero counters bypass chooser and add, and every nonzero chooser result removes as native.

source_edits.name: card_bring_to_light
source_edits.reason: Native 0x2457df2 test/0x2457df4 jns accepts only nonnegative tutor results after unconditional CSV-to-IID conversion. Restore >=0 instead of !=-1. Conversion, land check, legality query, chooser, play, kill and basic-spell continuation keep their order.

source_edits.name: card_guardian_idol
source_edits.reason: Native artifact_animation returns at 0x202f0e8, which writes the original player argument for get_card_instance at 0x202f0ef. The source instead reloaded parent_controller after animation. Use original player for the created legacy, preserving parent-based animation arguments and native player==IS_AI(player) quirk.

source_edits.name: card_elder_pine_of_jukai
source_edits.reason: Native reloads deck_ptr[player] separately for each reveal (second at 0x20b2950), then snapshots the scan pointer after count_deck at 0x20b29ad and only for positive count. Remove the source pointer cached before both show_deck callbacks. Preserve fresh current_turn for second reveal and saved scan pointer afterward.

source_edits.name: cast_counter_triggered_ability
source_edits.reason: Use separate stack index, selected card, target instance and IID roles. Preserve fresh stack_size after getter, stack_size-2 even when stack has one entry, target stores before IID queries, second getter on -1 and byte-sized target-count update.

source_edits.name: bloodcrazed_hoplite_effect
source_edits.reason: Share can_target continuation and restore countdown loop. Each iteration still queries instance before target construction; native AI/speculation predicate adds counter restriction, failed target availability exits and failed selection consumes one iteration.

source_edits.name: card_shared_animosity
source_edits.reason: Use descending attacker/ascending other-creature scans and a named bounded count. Preserve in_play/type/attacking/subtype callback order, fresh inner bound after callbacks and no pump for zero shared attackers.

source_edits.name: card_knight_of_the_widget
source_edits.reason: Restore c/IID/widget-count roles and a forward scan; native watermark query precedes permanent test. Negative IID fallback, fresh active-card bound and characteristic-PT update for zero count remain.

source_edits.name: new_special_count_grave
source_edits.reason: Separate saved grave cursor, current IID, test score and bounded match count. Preserve pointer increment before callback and next IID load after it. The matcher intentionally receives original player, including ANYBODY, rather than loop player.

source_edits.name: fx_when_creature_attacks_it_gains_p1
source_edits.reason: Restore milled-trigger and creature-count roles. Use forward scan with live num_cards_milled, retain invalid-source skip, empty/noncreature early returns and both separate post-creation getter calls.

source_edits.name: patient_rebuilding_legacy
source_edits.reason: Replace nested do/count idiom with forward live-bound land scan and one post-scan draw decision. Preserve matching-controller trigger guards, invalid-source skip and exile after optional draw.

source_edits.name: ereboss_titan_effect
source_edits.reason: Recover reverse scan and preview-card role. Preserve one initial grave count, fresh grave pointer/hand count per candidate, old grave index across chooser/discard and unconditional preview obliteration after choice.

source_edits.name: count_permanents_you_control_but_you_dont_own
source_edits.reason: Restore two-player/reverse-card scans and bounded stolen count. Keep native player-selector quirk (loop p==ANYBODY, not input player==ANYBODY), with in_play then type then stolen queries.

source_edits.name: card_ghoulraiser
source_edits.reason: Separate saved grave pointer, live count, candidate list and selected grave index. Preserve initial nonempty guard, count_graveyard before first/after every candidate, fixed native 60-entry array without added cap, RNG before selected IID and add before removal.

source_edits.name: card_sage_of_ancient_lore
source_edits.reason: Replace sign-bit De Morgan expression with its exact signed predicates player>=0 && card>=0. Preserve event-range/affected guards, helper order, ETB draw and characteristic hand-count read.

source_edits.name: activate_oran_rief_pump
source_edits.reason: Restore ordinary two-player/reverse-card scans. Keep per-player initial bound snapshots, in_play/type/just-entered checks and explicit sleighted-color-before-creature-color sequence before counter callback.

source_edits.name: card_amareth_the_lustrous
source_edits.reason: Use existing shared TUTOR_0 enum and name temporary preview_card by its role. Preserve saved library pointer before entered-type callback, top IID read after callback, temporary card getter/obliteration and boolean qty snapshot after test constructor.

source_edits.name: card_aquitects_will
source_edits.reason: Self-controlled branch: native 0x2590187 passes original player (ESI) to get_card_instance after legacy creation; rebuilt previously reloaded targets[0].player at 0x22e1436. Restore original player and explicitly sequence legacy lookup before get_hacked_subtype in both branches. Foreign branch retains fresh target-controller reads after creation and before obliteration.

source_edits.name: card_shielded_by_faith
source_edits.reason: Native 0x2353460/0x2353466 saves attached player/card before first get_cmc at 0x2353477; rebuilt previously read both after first call (0x20e3e11/0x20e3e18). Restore attachment snapshot and entering-CMC-before-attached-CMC order; retain optional human trigger, zero AI mode for foreign creature, ETB requery and aura continuation.

source_edits.name: card_powerstone_minefield
source_edits.reason: Native attacker byte is loaded before in_play at 0x2067bd5 and again after it at 0x2067c06. Remove cached card local; keep fresh current_turn arguments. Also retain native current-turn-first order for the two CHECK_PUMP writes (both players still receive -2).

source_edits.name: card_dwarven_catapult
source_edits.reason: Native queries instance on a paid non-token cast after played_for_free/is_token (0x2422665), or on resolution (0x24226d0), not at entry. Restore those query sites and explicit numerator snapshot before count_subtype. Preserve unguarded signed division, AI mana loop and dispatch on other events.

source_edits.name: card_kjeldoran_outpost
source_edits.reason: Native CAN_ACTIVATE path queries instance at 0x20a2d97 before mana_producer; the recovery previously skipped it. Include CAN_ACTIVATE in query dispatch and return the mana result after it; keep al_lands first and all activation/token paths unchanged.

source_edits.name: card_darksteel_mutation
source_edits.reason: Native snapshots attachment arguments before its first attachment lookup, then queries that saved pair again at 0x23c36b7 after create_a_card_type and stores. Restore fresh pointer for recalculation flags instead of reusing the pre-creation attachment pointer; retain cached-type fast path and allocation-failure return.

source_edits.name: card_grim_haruspex
source_edits.reason: Native own-instance lookup occurs after the STATIC_EFFECTS legacy search/creation (0x219dd3f); other events query before GFP processing. Move entry lookup to that common continuation, keeping fresh pointer after all static callbacks and before death counters/trigger checks.

source_edits.name: card_thawing_glaciers
source_edits.reason: Native has a second own-instance query for CAN_ACTIVATE without added mana, ACTIVATE, RESOLVE_ACTIVATION and CLEANUP, after EOT/bounce processing. Restore common requery after early mana/event returns, preserving original initial lookup for the bounce test and parent lookup on resolution.

source_edits.name: effect_nobody_can_attack_until_eot
source_edits.reason: Native uses separate own-instance lookups for begin-turn marker writes and cleanup marker read, while other countdown/flag operations retain the entry pointer. Restore those queries at native 0x2677764/0x26778e4 and 0x26777cb; preserve saved end_effect and post-kill flag reloads.

source_edits.name: generic_painland
source_edits.reason: COUNT_MANA native first gets instance and tests contamination (0x26822a7), then queries instance again for mana_color on either branch (0x26822c3/0x26824ca). Recovery read colors before the contamination query. Restore flag-query-before-color-query order, preserving replacement loops, AI checks and repeated damage quirks.

source_edits.name: cautery_sliver_shared_ability
source_edits.reason: Native first checks targets[1].player, then gets instance again at 0x23b4542 before snapshotting source player/card for leaves_play and humiliation. Restore the second query while retaining all subsequent native sliver ownership/activation behavior.

source_edits.name: card_isochron_scepter
source_edits.reason: Native imprint path gets instance only after successful selection, then again after original-IID query for target store, and after exile for count increment (0x253f158/0x253f188/0x253f1b0). CAN_ACTIVATE calls generic ability before per-condition and per-item fresh getters (0x253f287/0x253f29c). Restore those query lifetimes and remove the pre-dispatch getter on cleanup; ACTIVATE and RESOLVE_ACTIVATION keep their own entry snapshots.

source_edits.name: card_precursor_golem
source_edits.reason: Native spell trigger uses four separate queries: target count, target-card sentinel, saved target card, then target player before subtype query (0x2446ff9/0x2447015/0x2447035/0x2447054). Restore query order instead of sharing one pointer. Keep exact !=-1 predicate and subsequent battlefield scan/copy logic.

source_edits.name: damage_dealt_by_me_arbitrary
source_edits.reason: Native dead-source attachment scan gets each candidate separately for kind, source player, source card and source-card write; second check similarly requeries target player/card. Restore five conditional getters (native 0x268e076/0x268e0b3/0x268e0c7/0x268e0db/0x268e1b8), keeping live bounds and existing aura/equipment rerouting.

source_edits.name: reveal_card_until_you_reveal_test
source_edits.reason: Packed-quantity mode preserves initial low byte for wanted count, but native reloads high byte from test->qty after count_deck (0x269ade9/0x269ae00). Recovery used the old full quantity snapshot for both. Restore live high-byte read while preserving saved deck pointer, later count calls, native VLA size and reveal/effect order.

source_edits.name: card_kiora_master_of_the_depths
source_edits.reason: Native 0x24582e3/0x24582f5 and 0x245836d/0x2458372 decrement the remaining reveal count only for tutor results below unsigned 0x80000000, i.e. signed nonnegative results. The recovered !=-1 predicates also accepted other negative results. Restore both signed success checks, preserving live deck checks, minideck setup and final mill amount.

source_edits.name: count_for_gfp_ability_and_store_values_impl
source_edits.reason: Native 0x26945e5..0x26945f0 zero-extends the kill-code byte, subtracts one, compares unsigned against two and rejects above. Thus only kill codes 1..3 pass; zero must be rejected. The recovered signed arithmetic promoted uint8_t kill_code to int and accepted zero, compiled as only kill_code>3. Restore the explicit inclusive bury-through-sacrifice range before owner/test/callback/death-count processing.

source_edits.name: card_caught_in_the_brights
source_edits.reason: Native decrements the 32-bit info_slot value, then branches on the resulting sign. The signed-C subtraction permits GCC to replace that with a positive-slot test, differing at INT32_MIN. Convert to unsigned for the subtraction and back to int32_t before the existing index guard. Ordinary stored attacker counts behave identically; this restores the native wrap boundary without signed-overflow assumptions.
